WHAT I CHANGED
- New modules: resume_projection_integrity.py (audit_scope, ResumeScopePath, build_resume_projection_error, sticky helpers), resume_call_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, next_unused_retry_frame_id), resume_loop_progress.py (for_each/repeat_until bookkeeping rules), resume_root_guard.py (root checksum recheck), yaml_import_aliases.py (duplicate classic-YAML import detection on the composed node graph, so positions survive).
- state_projection.py: ResumeProjectionValidationError, enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary (real instance methods), CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias (set in lowering).
- state.py: record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure (raw-JSON read-modify-write of status, error, updated_at only), plus current_step_is_forensic used by report, dashboard cursor/projection and monitor messages.
- CLI resume: audit after the existing checksum precheck, before the observability override (moved), session, executor. Executor.execute: root-only checksum recheck then audit_scope before the prologue. CallExecutor.execute_call: on resume, resolves the caller via one resolve_call_boundary, selects the callee by the boundary's alias, completed-frame-collision check, lineage-based frame selection (never mapping order), failed predecessors checksum-validated and audited, running member audited, all after existing input/checksum/bound-input validation and before any callee frame/state is created. A child projection error is returned unchanged, never call_failed.
- Sticky failure: _handle_control_flow returns _stop and promotes the diagnostic to the run error (on_error=continue and routes cannot consume it); for_each stops after a failed iteration; repeat_until no longer wraps it; finalization records failure.error only as the cleanup's own projection error (null for an ordinary failure) and never replaces the run diagnostic.
- Typed provenance: frontend_kind='workflow_lisp' is set where Lisp bundles are lowered (lowering/core.py via elaborate_surface_workflow); build_frontend_bundle no longer overwrites it. _is_workflow_lisp_target now reads it.
- Docs: specs/state.md section and acceptance entries 201-208.
- Tests: tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (52 tests); updated characterization tests that encoded the old behaviour.

ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED / DISCARDED
- A max_iterations field on the loop projection to check repeat_until ranges: discarded because the structural goldens serialize every projection field. The auditor reads declared maxima from bundle.ir and passes them via enumerate_resume_slots(iteration_limits=...); the projection alone still validates everything that needs no maximum.
- Making frontend_kind drive the default-resume route: that broke every directly compiled .orc resume test, so that route still requires a frontend build root.
- Auditing child frames when the root is audited: rejected; audit_scope covers one scope and nested scopes are audited when reached.

DEVIATIONS / JUDGEMENT CALLS (please check)
- The CLI skips the audit when the run is already completed, so a no-op resume cannot overwrite a completed run with a failed envelope.
- An absent loop-frame row is tolerated for terminal exhausted repeat_until progress (several existing lexical-restore tests drop that row on purpose); a present row must match.
- current_step.step_id is strictly mandatory, so I added step_id to three legacy test fixtures. Rows with an explicit stale step_id are rejected, so characterization fixtures changed.
- Existing tests rewritten for the new contract: projection mutation-order and stale-caller characterizations, the call_frames-malformed tests (now bypass audit_scope to reach the call-level check), the drift test in test_workflow_lisp_lexical_checkpoint_restore, three mock-based CLI tests (patch audit_scope), the adjudication resume helper (steps over the root checksum guard), and two wcc structural goldens (new import_alias key).
- Mock bundles are tolerated by duck typing in audit_scope; missing import_alias counts as an alias mismatch.

VERIFICATION
Full suite run: 64 failures remain, all failing identically on the pristine baseline (checked by stashing); one adjudication deadline test is timing-flaky and passes on rerun. The dev-check selectors and the touched suites pass.

NOT COVERED
- No end-to-end tmux/orchestrator demo smoke run. No dedicated test for loop-contained call-boundary ids beyond for_each local ids, nested loops inside loops, or the heartbeat/stalled paths beyond the status snapshot and markdown. Retry-lineage resumption through a real Workflow Lisp child with several failed predecessors is covered at the lineage-function level, not end to end. Pyright cleanliness was not fully checked.
